blockingFindings.title: R10 contracts are only delegated to passing external tests
blockingFindings.rationale: The coverage artifact marks R10 covered by this spec-local file, but the actual spec-local test lacks corresponding coverage for most of R10 and could pass without exercising those acceptance requirements.
blockingFindings.issue: The R10 test only checks SPEC_CORRECTION_SUPPORTED_STAGES and that six existing unit test files exist and pass. It does not spec-locally assert the required repair migration fingerprint/delta behavior, tracked uncommitted diff identity bytes, tooling recovery exhaustion threshold, latest repairFingerprint obligation filtering with legacy retention, or scenario-validity preflight bypass condition.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local assertions or static contract checks that bind each R10 sub-requirement to the intended production behavior, rather than only executing pre-existing test files.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact marks R10 covered by this spec-local file, but the actual spec-local test lacks corresponding coverage for most of R10 and could pass without exercising those acceptance requirements.

blockingFindings.title: R3 verdict policy coverage relies on source-token presence
blockingFindings.rationale: A source-token check can pass from comments, imports, or dead code and does not exercise production verdict behavior, so the test has a static anti-pattern that would pass without validating the required policy.
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test validates missing_tests and missing_required_tests with production context, but blocked, repair_required, user_decision_required, and pass verdict policy are only checked as strings in productionContractCorpus plus delegated historical execution.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable spec-local assertions that construct the relevant acceptance-review states and assert the four required verdict outcomes.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A source-token check can pass from comments, imports, or dead code and does not exercise production verdict behavior, so the test has a static anti-pattern that would pass without validating the required policy.

blockingFindings.title: R9 weakened-assertion guard is source-text based
blockingFindings.rationale: The test can pass while the target regression files no longer assert the required behavior, which is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R9 attempts to ensure assertions are not weakened by counting test/it calls and checking required assertion anchor strings. These anchors can be present in comments, helper names, or unrelated literals, and the generic assert regex only proves that some assertion exists somewhere in the file.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace source-token anchors with executable checks for the specific preserved behaviors or a stricter structural check that ties each required anchor to an actual assertion path.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test can pass while the target regression files no longer assert the required behavior, which is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising production behavior.
